race.description: Dandy Cup Ladies Day Sat 17 Oct Country Boosted Hcp (Bm66)
race.comment: CHESTIME (8) was heavily backed and justified the support when resuming last start over 1250m at Taree, scoring by 1.4 lengths. Open to plenty of improvement and another win looks on the cards. ZOUCRATIC (10) has been in great form with two placings in succession, most recently when beaten half a length into third after he gave away a big start over 1200m at Mudgee. Best figures measure up and is sure to run well. GREEN RUN (3) strips fitter second-up from the break and gets some weight off with the 2kg claim. Top-three prospects. NEWS BOUND (11) defied a lack of market support last start, scoring by a head over 1200m at Mudgee. High on confidence now and should measure up again.
